name: Smeden
description: En stærk, selvsikker og snu håndværker, der har skrevet kontrakt med Fanden og bruger listede ønsker til at vende magtforholdet på hovedet.
visualPrompt: A sturdy Nordic blacksmith with soot-smudged face and thick arms, wearing a leather apron over simple work clothes, holding a heavy sledgehammer; sharp, cunning eyes and a slightly mocking expression; standing amid an old-fashioned forge with anvil, bellows, and glowing coals.

name: Vor Herre
description: En rolig vandringsmand med myndig mildhed, der viser smeden en overnaturlig smedekunst og giver ham tre ønsker.
visualPrompt: A calm, humble-looking wandering man with gentle authority, wearing plain travel robes in muted tones; serene face, steady gaze; subtle sense of holiness without overt symbols; standing near the forge fire, hands poised as if blessing skilled work.

name: St. Peder
description: Vor Herres følgesvend, der kommenterer smedens tåbelige ønsker og repræsenterer den fromme eftertanke.
visualPrompt: An older bearded man with weathered kind features, wearing simple pilgrim-like garments; cautious, observant posture; expression mixing concern and dry disbelief; standing slightly behind the holy wanderer on a dusty road.

name: Fanden
description: En stolt og letnarret djævel, der forsøger at hente smeden på kontrakten, men fanges af pæretræet, lænestolen og den gloende pung.
visualPrompt: A horned devil with a wiry, cunning build, dark reddish-brown skin, sharp grin, and restless eyes; expression shifting from smug confidence to panic; clawed hands and a tail; depicted near a pear tree or recoiling from a glowing steel purse, in a grim folk-tale style.

name: Skræddersvenden
description: En tynd og hastende rejsende mod Himmerige, der uforvarende bliver målestok for smedens voldsomme slutspurt mod porten.
visualPrompt: A slender young tailor’s journeyman in simple, worn clothes, hurrying forward with a small pressing iron in hand; anxious but hopeful expression; dust on shoes from long travel; set against a forked country road leading toward distant gates.
